intro: While exploring the rugged wastes of Durotar, travelers stumble across a plain, discarded journal chronicling the quiet travels of an unfamiliar figure. Its pages speak warmly of outdoor life and camping out under the stars, awaiting delivery to Brakk near Razor Hill.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The journal appears to be quite plain, detailing the life and adventures of someone you've never heard of.
There are multiple entries mentioning camping. It seems to be quite... Fun.
